fixed-term Pūkenga Iwi & Hapū role in Te Whare Aronui

1.0 FTE Fixed Term Full time (Maternity cover)
Ōtaki Campus ﻿

Kia rangatira te tū a Te Wānanga o Raukawa, hei whare ako whakatupu hoki i te mātauranga.


Applications are now being sought to fulfill a busy and dynamic Pūkenga role, covering maternity-leave, within Te Whare Aronui.


As Pūkenga you will contribute to the learning journey of our tauira. This diverse role is responsible for the delivery of your tohu ensuring it is consistent with the kaupapa of Te Wananga o Raukawa.

The ideal candidates for these positions:


- Hold relevant academic qualifications and/or relevant experience in the field

- Have a good working knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 and Mūrau

- Establish and maintain positive working relationships

- Communicates well in Te Reo Māori in a style suited to the intended audience.

- Good administration and computer skills, and

- Have the ability to work well within a team and multitask.


Applications close: Mon 29th June, 2026


For further information or to apply for this role contact:

Samantha Hata, Paihere Tangata

Whare Tiaki Rawa

Sam.hata@twor.ac.nz
